chemistry-killer-03.title: I-14 g ye-nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$)
chemistry-killer-03.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-03.material: I-14 g ye-nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) kunye ne-4 g ye-hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) zisabela ngokupheleleyo kwisitya ukwenza i-ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Intsabela yi-$\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, ngobunzima beeathom H = 1, N = 14, kwaye iqhubeka de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo ubunzima (g) be-$\mathrm{NH_3}$ eyenziweyo kunye nomthamo wayo yonke igesi esesityeni emva kokusabela, uguqulelwe kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L), ngokulandelelana?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: I-14 g ye-nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) kunye ne-4 g ye-hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) zisabela ngokupheleleyo kwisitya ukwenza i-ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Intsabela yi-$\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, ngobunzima beeathom H = 1, N = 14, kwaye iqhubeka de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo ubunzima (g) be-$\mathrm{NH_3}$ eyenziweyo kunye nomthamo wayo yonke igesi esesityeni emva kokusabela, uguqulelwe kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L), ngokulandelelana?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Iimoli. $\mathrm{N_2}$ 14 g / 28 g/mol = 0.5 mol; $\mathrm{H_2}$ 4 g / 2 g/mol = 2 mol.
Inyathelo 2: Yahlula ngeekoefisiyenti. $\mathrm{N_2}$: 0.5/1 = 0.5; $\mathrm{H_2}$: 2/3 ≈ 0.67. Ixabiso elincinci lelika-$\mathrm{N_2}$, isabelayo ephelayo.
Inyathelo 3: 0.5 mol ye-$\mathrm{N_2}$ isabela ne-1.5 mol ye-$\mathrm{H_2}$ inike i-1.0 mol ye-$\mathrm{NH_3}$. Ubunzima = 1.0 x 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ eshiyekileyo = 2 - 1.5 = 0.5 mol.
Inyathelo 4: Igesi iyonke = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol, umthamo kwi-STP = 1.5 x 22.4 = 33.6 L.
Iimpendulo: 17 g, 33.6 L (c). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-22.4 L ihoya i-H2 eshiyekileyo; i-34 g idibanisa iimoli neekoefisiyenti; i-8.5 g ithatha i-N2:NH3 njenge-1:1.)

chemistry-killer-03.steps.0.prompt: I-14 g ye-nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) kunye ne-4 g ye-hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) zisabela ngokupheleleyo kwisitya ukwenza i-ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Intsabela yi-$\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, ngobunzima beeathom H = 1, N = 14, kwaye iqhubeka de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo ubunzima (g) be-$\mathrm{NH_3}$ eyenziweyo kunye nomthamo wayo yonke igesi esesityeni emva kokusabela, uguqulelwe kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L), ngokulandelelana?
